name: Chaos Prince
source:
A minor antagonist in the 2nd main quest's episode 1 "Little Mermaid Story Zone".

He is the older brother of Revol. He initially blames Revol for the murder of his wife, unaware that he himself got manipulated by Chaos Siren to kill her.
